entities.name: Early Christianity
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The movement that emerged from the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus of Nazareth (c. 30–325 CE). Spread from Jerusalem through the Roman Empire by the apostles and missionaries, enduring persecution until Constantine's legalization (313 CE) and the Council of Nicaea (325 CE).
